# Symbols Nerd Font Mono

`src/components/terminal/fonts/SymbolsNerdFontMono-Regular.woff2` is the
unmodified `SymbolsNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf` of the Nerd Fonts v3.4.0 release
(`NerdFontsSymbolsOnly.zip`, https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/tag/v3.4.0),
recompressed to WOFF2 with fontTools (no glyph, metric or name change).

- zip sha256: `8e617904b980fe3648a4b116808788fe50c99d2d495376cb7c0badbd8a564c47`
- ttf sha256: `f0f624d9b474bea1662cf7e862d44aebe1ae1f6c7f9cb7a0ca5d0e5ac9561c60`
- woff2 sha256: `87a026dee6f8f211e18ea783874504395dfbcc8840f428d3351dd626d363f5a5`

The in-chat terminal uses it only as a fallback after the system monospace
font, so shell prompts (Powerlevel10k, Oh My Posh, Starship) draw their icons
and Powerline separators instead of empty boxes.
